question: Settle two points on data-apis/ip2location-lite. First, free_tier.stated says the LITE data is updated monthly, but the LITE page lists the update frequency as Semi-monthly, and the DB11 page lists current version 01 November 2026 with next update 15 November 2026 (an earlier read showed 15 October 2026 as the current version); the FAQ asks for one download a month in the first week. Read the pages again and decide the wording. Second, download.ip2location.com/lite/ serves the DB1 (country) LITE files with no account or token (a HEAD request for IP2LOCATION-LITE-DB1.CSV.ZIP answered HTTP 200 with content-length 2610652 on 2026-11-02, and the DB11 file answered HTTP 404 there): decide whether that open path is a record of its own with identity anonymous, or a tier of this record.
why: A verify unit cannot add a record, and the monthly wording rests on a statement that two other statements of the vendor contradict.
